test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Feb, 2026 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Choose the most suitable one-word substitution for the following.

The art of motion-picture photography.
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. Cinematography**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"Cinematography"** refers to the art and technology of motion-picture photography, involving techniques such as lighting, framing, and camera motion. (सिनेमेटोग्राफी: चलचित्र छायांकन की कला) • **Example:** The cinematography in the film was breathtaking, especially the use of lighting in the final scene. Correct Explanation: The term "cinematography" is directly related to motion pictures and their visual representation, which aligns perfectly with the given question. (सही उत्तर सिनेमेटोग्राफी है क्योंकि यह चलचित्र छायांकन की कला से संबंधित है।) • **Example:** The director hired a renowned cinematographer to ensure the film's visuals were of the highest quality. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. Cinematography**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Calligraphy **(सुलेख): The art of beautiful handwriting or decorative writing. • **Example:** She learned calligraphy to design elegant wedding invitations. • **Lithography **(पत्थर मुद्रण): A printing process that uses a stone or metal plate with a completely smooth surface. • **Example:** The artist created a series of lithographs to showcase his work. • **Photography **(फोटोग्राफी): The art or practice of taking and processing photographs. • **Example:** Her love for photography began when she got her first camera as a gift. 207:Tae5, The correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. maze**.
